components.description: Federal FMLA as implemented in PPM 4860.040 A: up to 12 workweeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period for the birth, adoption or foster placement of a child (within 12 months), the employee's own serious health condition, or care of a spouse, child or parent with a serious health condition.

notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. All four copies predate it (Wayback 2017-12-26 and 2018-02-09) and carry revision dates in 2015-2017.

Governing documents: PPM Chapter 4860 (leave policy for all employees, faculty included; Handbook D43 refers faculty to it) and University Handbook Sections C (C83 tenure clock) and D (D90 modified instructional duties). Handbook Section E states that it 'is for general information and reference only' and that the PPM governs; it is used for faculty-specific wording where it agrees with the PPM, and alone only for the disability income benefit (E87), whose governing chapter PPM 4820 is cited but not saved (governing document cited but not saved: coded as stated, flagged cross_reference_not_saved, not summary_only).

No dedicated paid maternity, paternity or parental leave and no childbirth period appear in any source. Paid time for a birth comes only from the employee's own accrued sick leave (and, for 12-month appointees, vacation), which R1 counts as 0 paid weeks. Section E10 names 'parental leave' among the purposes of discretionary leave without pay (c6, general purpose).
Calendar: D90.2 states the semester calendar ('one semester (i.e., fall or spring)') without a length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth): sabbatical leave, donor leave, job injury leave, administrative leave, disaster service volunteer leave, funeral/bereavement leave, inclement weather leave, jury duty, military leave, workers' compensation supplement, phased retirement, retirement health care bridge, tenure-clock delay for programmatic reasons (C83.3).

Whose figures: a main-campus tenure-stream member with two years of service is FMLA-eligible (12 months, 1,250 hours) and, as a nine-month faculty member, earns sick leave but no vacation leave and no discretionary day.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (unpaid, job-protected; accrued sick leave, then advanced leave and shared leave where granted, used within or after it) ; modified instructional duties for one semester also available (discretionary, at full salary), before or after FMLA, no order stated ; tenure-clock delay of one year on request.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (unpaid; sick leave usable for care of the birth parent within it) ; modified instructional duties for one semester also available if the primary caregiver (more than 50% of care), discretionary ; tenure-clock delay of one year on request.

Cross-references cited but not saved that bear on leave: The Kansas Administrative Regulations, Article 9; Kansas Board of Regents Policy Manual; Department of Labor FMLA poster; PPM Chapter 4220 (Hours of Work); PPM Chapter 4210; PPM Chapter 4820 (Insurance Programs); PPM Chapter 4810 (Retirement Plans); PPM Chapter 4460; PPM 4075 Lactation Support for Nursing Mothers (navigation link only); Advanced Leave Agreement (PER-60); Memorandum of Agreement Regarding Leave Without Pay; Change or Separation Form (PER-39); sabbatical leave guidelines (Provost Office).
